title: Dry-Run Apply, Validation, Transactional Activation & Rollback Receipt
objective: Before a pack/component becomes active, calculate the dependency/apply plan, validate references/rights/compatibility, show conflicts, and support atomic activation or rollback. Produce a deterministic receipt listing activated components, versions, dependencies, extensions and failures without bypassing existing owner-domain validation.

scope.purpose: Provide dry-run dependency/apply planning, pre-activation validation, atomic activation/rollback semantics and deterministic receipts without bypassing existing owner authorities.
scope.completion_gate: A representative pack/component activation can be dry-run deterministically, fails closed on invalid references/rights/compatibility/conflicts, commits atomically only through existing owner validation paths, rolls back atomically on failure, and emits a deterministic receipt covering components, versions, dependencies, extensions and failures.

selection_boundaries: CNI-10 is completed_verified before CNI-11 implementation.
CNI-11 consumes CNI-02 compatibility constraints and CNI-09 extension/conflict analysis rather than replacing their authorities.
ARI remains resource identity/rights authority; Action/Event and owner domains retain canonical validation and mutation authority.
CNI-11 may plan, validate, activate or roll back only through existing owner-domain validation/mutation paths; it creates no parallel owner authority.
CNI-12+, PCA, MAS and SMB-08 remain unauthorized while CNI-11 is in progress.
next_action: Establish causal CNI-11 RED on the authorized application branch, then implement the minimum deterministic dry-run planning, fail-closed validation, transactional activation/rollback and receipt contract.
